scripts.check:public: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('public/schedule.sleepy')) { console.error('Missing public/schedule.sleepy: copy your Android-exported .sleepy file there before building.'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.public:key-hash: node -e "const crypto=require('node:crypto'); const key=process.argv[1]; if (!key) { console.error('Usage: npm run public:key-hash -- <access-key>'); process.exit(1) } console.log(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex'))"
scripts.build:public: npm run check:public && tsc -b && VITE_PUBLIC_SCHEDULE_PATH=/schedule.sleepy BASE_PATH=/ vite build --mode public
